calibration.task: Round-8 recount (4 workers): re-run every counting command in reports/round-8/validation.json claims' measurement blocks; compare observed vs recorded; per-command receipts reports/round-12/recount/r8-<k>.md.
Round-11 recount, same protocol — MUST independently reproduce the F-failure numbers (0.778 stability, 45 dispositions, 147/192).
Audit ledger scribes: merge receipts into reports/round-12/recount/ledger.json {command, round, recorded, observed, match|disposition}.
Dispositions: every mismatch named (environmental | legitimate-change | defect) with evidence.
Recount auditors: independently re-run >=8 recounted commands; mismatch with the ledger = finding.

operability.task: Defect sweep (2 workers per round 8-11): conformance review of the round report + artifacts vs protocol (SHONEN heading, hash citations resolve, LOG entries, marker-vs-report); findings to reports/round-12/defects/sweep-r<N>.md.
Bounded fixers: small fixes (typo-level, pointer-level) with demonstrated before/after controls; anything larger routed, not fixed.
Routers: every non-fixed finding routed to round 14 with owner note in reports/round-12/defects/routed.md.
Regression runners: battery + craft + d2/d3 selftests green post-fixes.

adjacency.task: New-entry bleed check: read all 10 round-10 entries + round-11/12 changes; flag any canon claim, rights ruling, or game-mechanics content (out of province).
Handoff contract audit: worldbible-integration-contract.md fields vs the round-11 exercise packet; lore-boundary notes.
PROVINCE.md accuracy check vs the actual four rounds of new capability; correction entry if drifted (LOG it).
